entities.name: Joel Parra López
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joel Parra López is a Spanish professional basketball player for FC Barcelona of the Spanish Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. He has also represented the Spain national team. Standing at 6 ft 8 in, Parra can play both as a small forward and a power forward.
